messages:
Ana (partnerships): FYI we have a new partner, NovaEdge, asking to list in the marketplace. Launch window ~3 weeks. Compliance asks: SOC2 Type II, recent pen test, and that short vendor questionnaire. Who should lead artifact intake?
Diego (security): I can own acceptance criteria. Quick Q: is the pen-test vendor-provided or do we require a 3rd-party witness? Both are ok but doc should state expectations.
Rohit (SI): NovaEdge is doing an internal pentest with an external firm co-signed. They prefer uploading individual files rather than a single monolith. Ops-wise either works.
Nora (platform-eng): From an automation POV a single bundle + manifest is simpler to validate. Recommend manifest-first workflow: vendor uploads manifest.json, we validate and then issue presigned URLs for each artifact.
Sasha (legal): We'll need a signed attestation (vendor officer) saying they removed customer data and that artifacts are accurate. Also retention terms: default 12 months, retention override needs contract amendment.
Diego (security): Draft acceptance checklist (short): 1) SOC2 PDF + scope statement 2) Pen-test report + scope + remediation plan 3) Completed questionnaire (JSON) 4) Signed attestation 5) Hashes (sha256) in manifest 6) No live credentials
Ana (partnerships): For the questionnaire, can we provide a JSON schema so vendors can export answers? That'll make ingestion easier.
Rohit (SI): Yes. We'll publish a small schema + example. Also recommend vendors include optional sanitized request logs if pen-test references endpoints.
Nora (platform-eng): Proposed manifest example (very small):
```json
{
  "vendor": "NovaEdge",
  "listing_id": "nova-2025-06",
  "bundle_ts": "2025-06-10T09:00:00Z",
  "items": [
    {"type": "soc2", "file": "soc2-2024.pdf", "sha256": "<hex>", "scope": "platform"},
    {"type": "pentest", "file": "pentest-2025-05.pdf", "sha256": "<hex>", "scope": "edge"},
    {"type": "questionnaire", "file": "qna.json", "sha256": "<hex>", "scope": "listing"}
  ]
}
```
Diego (security): Automation checks: file types, presence of attestation, matching hashes, pen-test age <= 12 months flagged. Manual review: redaction check on PDFs unless they used our redaction helper.
Sasha (legal): I'll draft attestation language. Minimal: vendor name, officer name/title, statement that PII/customer data removed, date, signature.
Ana (partnerships): Upload path convention? Suggest `marketplace/intake/<vendor>/<listing_id>/<bundle_ts>/`. Keeps lifecycle tidy.
Nora (platform-eng): Agreed. We'll create intake lambda that consumes manifest, validates hashes, and moves artifacts to long-term storage. Also store `index.csv` inside bundle for human-readable audit.
Rohit (SI): For presigns: vendor posts manifest, we validate, then create per-file presigned PUTs. If vendor wants to upload directly to a ZIP we can support but it's more complex.
Diego (security): Reject criteria: any artifacts containing live creds, pen-test executed >18 months ago (auto-reject) or not accompanied by remediation timeline.
intake-bot: Ticket created: INTAKE-7832 (owner=Ana, due=2025-06-18).
Ana (partnerships): Action list: Diego finalizes acceptance checklist + redaction helper by Wed EOD. Sasha drafts attestation wording by Thu. Rohit publishes questionnaire schema + upload guide. Nora wires manifest validator and index template. I'll set onboarding call with NovaEdge and share timeline. :calendar:
